item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 3/6/2026
item.description: Bob and Dima recap Southern Miss beating James Madison in men’s basketball, 86-80, in the Third Round of the 2026 Sun Belt Championship on Thursday night at the Pensacola Bay Center. Plus, former Southern Miss baseball player and current President and CEO of Forrest Health, Jeff Cook.

item.title: Second penguin hatchings in Mississippi history announced
item.description: Mississippi Aquarium’s penguin colony has grown. Officials announced on Friday that four African penguin chicks hatched in late January. The chicks were born to mated penguin pairs at the aquarium.
